beats.say: 86 years: Sir Patrick Stewart's life ended
He was born on 13 July 1940 in Mirfield, West Riding of Yorkshire, and went on to become a renowned actor
Sir Patrick Stewart was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2010 for his services to drama, a testament to his dedication to the craft
His legacy includes memorable roles in Star Trek and Shakespearean theatre, leaving a lasting impact on the world of acting
Sir Patrick Stewart passed away at his home in Los Angeles on 28 October 2026, leaving behind a lifetime of iconic performances that will be remembered for generations to come
